settings.headline: Privacy Policy
settings.image_alt: Senseless range on a warm off-white background

settings.headline: Introduction
settings.body: This policy explains how Senseless (a trading name of Matrix Health Group Ltd) collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you visit our website, make a purchase, or communicate with us. We are committed to protecting your privacy in accordance with UK data protection law, including the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR) and the Data Protection Act 2018. Contact for data-protection enquiries: cs@senseless.uk.

settings.headline: What we collect
settings.body:
• Information you provide — name, email, postal address, phone number, and payment details when you order or contact us.
  • Automatic information — IP address, browser type, device information, and how you interact with our site, via cookies and similar technologies.
  • Third-party information — payment processors and Shopify may provide information needed to complete your order.

settings.headline: How we use it
settings.body: To process and fulfil orders, communicate about your purchases, respond to enquiries, improve our site and services, comply with legal obligations, and prevent fraud. Marketing is sent only with your consent, and you can opt out at any time.

settings.headline: Who we share it with
settings.body: Only where necessary: Shopify (our e-commerce platform), payment processors, delivery partners, and where required by law. We do not sell your personal information.

settings.headline: Cookies
settings.body: We use cookies to operate the site, remember preferences, and understand usage. Full detail in our Cookie Policy.

settings.headline: Your rights
settings.body: Under UK GDPR you can access, correct, or delete your data, restrict or object to processing, and request portability. Contact cs@senseless.uk; we respond within 30 days. You may also complain to the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) at ico.org.uk.

settings.headline: Data retention
settings.body: Held only as long as necessary for the purposes collected, including legal, accounting, or reporting requirements. Order data is retained for six years per UK tax and accounting obligations.

settings.question: Who is the data controller?
settings.answer: Matrix Health Group Ltd, registered in England and Wales (17099304). Contact: cs@senseless.uk.

settings.question: How do I opt out of marketing?
settings.answer: Use the unsubscribe link in any marketing email, or contact cs@senseless.uk.

settings.question: Where can I complain?
settings.answer: Contact us first; if unsatisfied, the ICO at ico.org.uk.
